entry_points.text: Early guard setup creates randomised per-task canary and enables pointer authentication; global publication applies only when per-task guards are off.

exports.text: Logical CPU numbers translate to architectural MPIDR values via a per-index table.
Non-protected hypervisor unwind initialises common state from caller frame and PC.

hazards.text: Single-CPU wakeup is unavailable and fails at build time; logical CPU teardown is an empty no-op.
Receive/transmit debug transfer share one encoding with direction from access; active-priority fixed aliases equal parameterised forms, so writes via one name show via the other.

Endian selection, physical-range maximum, granule family and tag exclusion have mutually exclusive build alternatives; assuming fixed page size, endian, large-page support or mask misreads controls and bounds.
Physical coverage allows up to 52 bits with active limit from mask shift; sparse sections use 29 or 27 bits; granule minima/maxima and 32-bit PARANGE floor bound supported configurations.
Post-spinlock barrier is full; vCPU preemption reports not preempted; compat status layout ends with 64-bit inode and flags broken intermediate field.

invariants.text: Hash capacity is two to the power of stored bits; logical lookup scans the ID map and fails on no match.
SGI shares one ID per kind with hidden marking; LPI uses per-CPU IDs with forced affinity, no auto-enable and hidden plus non-balancing marks; request failures warn and continue.
Secondary status publication uses a single store plus inner-shareable barrier for polling observers.

IRQ, overflow, EFI and SDEI ranges derive from per-CPU bases plus sizes except firmware from a global top; missing SDEI degrades to unknown; advance needs aligned known-stack pointers with single-copy load.
Second-stage depth derives from guest size and from virtualization control; minimum cache pages are depth minus one.

Call number lives in a dedicated field; minus one suppresses dispatch with ENOSYS; rollback restores arg0; results sign-extend or truncate for compat; reads use saved arg0, writes keep live and saved coherent.

Native wrappers source arg0 from saved original with conversion and validation; compat wrappers source six live registers with delousing; both support zero-arg and weak conditional forms plus error injection.

EL2 MMU-on adds MMU, caches, alignment, error sync, XN, endian and barriers to RES1, MMU-off is RES1 plus endian; EL1 MMU-off is endian plus alignment, tagging and traps, MMU-on adds MMU, caches, checks and PAN/spec controls; endian has two variants.

Encodings alias instruction and register forms with Op2 extraction; state fields cover PAN, UAO, SSBS, DIT and TCO; indexed families mask inputs into CRm or Op2, with banked aliases equal to parameterised forms at 0..3.

Address translate uses fixed leading code with EL1/EL2 selector covering S1, S12, EL0/EL1 and permission variants; TLBI shares leading code with level, pacing and shareability selectors across full, VA, ASID, last-level, range and stage-two IPA shapes.
Boot, IPI, guard and syscall behaviour depends on external percpu access, task info, IRQ setup and affinity, CPU masks, warnings, once-access, bitops, build checks and random canary facilities.

state_machines.text: Parked secondary waits in low-power event loop; panic variant records panic status on entry.
Spectre exposure is unaffected, mitigated or vulnerable, mutually exclusive.
Hypervisor vectors select direct, direct with hardening bounce, indirect mapping bounce, or indirect with hardening; direct is zero default when no mitigation applies.

structs.text: Secondary bring-up pairs incoming task with status word; MPIDR hash stores 64-bit mask, four affinity shifts and total bit count.
Stack descriptors hold low/high bounds; unwind cursors hold FP, PC, current range plus table and length; frames pair FP with return address plus optional type tag 0 untagged, 1 terminal, 2 regs.
Suspend state is 16-byte aligned context words plus SP with callee-saved extension matching save/restore order; sizes are fourteen context and twelve callee-saved slots.
Per-CPU hardening pairs hypervisor vector mode with parameterless callback; EL2 reserves four slots with vector area from all but one times 2KB.
System instruction fields fix Op0 shift 19 mask 3, Op1 shift 16 mask 7, CRn shift 12 mask 15, CRm shift 8 mask 15, Op2 shift 5 mask 7.
Attributes distinguish device nGnRnE, nGnRE, normal non-cacheable, tagged and cacheable with mask and slot helper; FP, SME and SVE pairs enable EL1 and conditional EL0; safe MPIDR sets only top bit.

Failure flag is bit 0; on failure bits carry fault status, walk, stage and assured/top/overlay/dirty markers, on success shareability, security, PA and attributes; tagging uses random bit, exclusion, kernel default, tag mask and fault bits.

EL2 exposes guest interrupt controls, two banks of eight list registers, context IDs, activity offsets and timer state; EL2 aliases EL1 MMU, exception, fault, attribute, vector, context and timer state with distinct second field.
